data.title: Central China Securities Advances Digital Equity Fund With New Partnership Terms
data.description:
Central China Securities Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:1375) ) has issued an update.

Central China Securities has reported progress on establishing the Henan Xiangding Digital Equity Investment Fund Partnership, after its affiliated fund manager ZDKY Venture Capital signed a supplemental agreement with several partners and completed private fund filing with the Asset Management Association of China. The updated arrangements clarify how ZDKY Venture Capital may invest and withdraw its own capital, its obligations to disclose related parties, and a tiered income distribution structure that prioritizes capital recovery and allocates excess returns above a 6% annualized rate between executive partners and other investors.

The supplemental agreement requires ZDKY Venture Capital to give advance notice and obtain consent before using its own funds in the partnership, sets a minimum six-month holding period, and outlines exceptions when its ownership share is passively increased due to changes in fund size. It also mandates timely disclosure of related-party lists to investors and introduces a waterfall for profits in which partners first recoup paid-in capital and then share investment income, with a performance-based split that assigns 20% of excess income over a 6% hurdle to the two executive partners and 80% to all partners based on their capital contributions.
